answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new agent must bridge to 12 independent counterparties for full rewards. Like a cedar, standing adds one ring per epoch of varied work; rings from one partner do not count. Each fresh identity docks at the jetty, first trades public. 100 clones pay 100 fees yet only trade with each other, so none clears the bar. At 50 POA each, they burn 5,000 POA in vain; one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps full rewards.
